recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow source fix that restores the approved conformance strength for failed transactions without disturbing later clarifications for other HTTP error contexts.
issue_request: FHIR-14495 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core request to make HTTP-page wording consistent about when OperationOutcome can, should, or shall be returned. Its resolution made conditional-operation unsupported responses MAY include OperationOutcome, search failures SHALL use 4xx/5xx with OperationOutcome language that later issues refined, and failed transactions SHALL return a single OperationOutcome instead of a Bundle.
initial_application: The historical application was git-svn commit 8d445f4fd526686ddea36b5fb584fd6feaf1a2a7 (svn revision 14109), which changed source/http.html conditional-operation and search-failure wording. That commit did not add SHALL to the failed-transaction sentence; later source history fixed the conditional create/delete labels and search-failure ambiguity, leaving this failed-transaction conformance verb as the remaining seed-level mismatch.
additional_context: FHIR-8992 is an earlier Published same-change-family issue that introduced the failed-transaction OperationOutcome rule. FHIR-27051 and FHIR-30240 later clarified that OperationOutcome is not mandatory for every generic 4xx/5xx search or authorization response, so the current SHOULD-level search wording should remain. A 2024 Zulip implementers thread confirmed the interpretation that a failed transaction response is a single OperationOutcome and no Bundle.
reconciliation: Changed source/http.html in the Batch/Transaction Response section from "the server returns a single OperationOutcome" to "the server SHALL return a single OperationOutcome".
source_changes: source/http.html:1957 changed the failed transaction sentence to say the server SHALL return a single OperationOutcome instead of a Bundle.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue establishing that failed transactions return an OperationOutcome rather than a transaction-response Bundle.
Later Published clarification split search failure into a required 4xx/5xx status and SHOULD-level OperationOutcome for FHIR-aware failures.
Related later clarification that OperationOutcome should not be read as mandatory for all 401/403 responses.
Conditional delete support wording was separately corrected to preserve the MAY include OperationOutcome outcome.
Conditional create support wording was separately corrected to preserve the MAY include OperationOutcome outcome.
